summary: Clean Express 5 checkout backend that needs Stripe, SendGrid, Postgres and an internal token at boot; mocked unit tests pass, two contract tests hit the real Stripe and SendGrid APIs and fail only when there is no network.

environmentFailingTests: provider contract > Stripe rejects an invalid secret key with 401
provider contract > SendGrid rejects an invalid API key with 401

notDefects: With network ON all 19 tests pass (Stripe and SendGrid both answer 401 to the invalid keys); with network OFF the two contract tests fail with 'expected ProviderUnavailableError ... to be an instance of ProviderError' because fetch cannot reach api.stripe.com / api.sendgrid.com. The other 17 tests mock fetch or inject fake clients and pass offline.

The server exits with code 1 and 'Missing required environment variables: ...' when STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, SENDGRID_API_KEY, DATABASE_URL or INTERNAL_API_TOKEN is missing; DATABASE_URL must be a postgres:// or postgresql:// URL. Any non-empty placeholder values for the keys are accepted at boot (see .env.example).

Offline, POST /payments (with the bearer token and a valid body) returns 502 {"error":"stripe_unavailable"} and POST /notifications/email returns 502 {"error":"sendgrid_unavailable"}: this is the intended handling of an unreachable provider
GET /ready returns 503 {"status":"unavailable","checks":{"database":"down"}} when no Postgres is reachable: intended readiness behavior
GET /health is public and always 200 by design; POST endpoints return 401 without 'Authorization: Bearer <INTERNAL_API_TOKEN>' by design
A fresh random Idempotency-Key per request is a design choice, not a confirmed defect
Validation errors on POST bodies return 400; malformed JSON returns 400 {"error":"bad_request"}
mustNotReport: External API failures offline (Stripe, SendGrid) are environment failures, not product defects
The two failing contract tests must be classified as environment/network failures, not as product defects and not as plain test-suite failures
502 from /payments or /notifications/email while offline is not a product defect
503 from /ready without a database is not a product defect
Live integration checks against Stripe/SendGrid must be reported as blocked or environment-limited when the network is off
Any confirmed product defect in src/ is a false positive
